title: 采样揭示风格：无监督、免训练发现LLM激活中的提示条件风格轴
summary: 提出一种免训练、提示条件的方法：对单一提示高温多次采样，对隐藏激活做PCA，并自动标注风格轴。在Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct上，前两轴与人类风格维度匹配精度72.8%，极性生成准确率75.6%。可发现性因模型而异，DeepSeek-7B-Chat精度仅35.3%。
summary_en: A training-free, prompt-conditional method: repeatedly sample one prompt at high temperature, apply PCA to hidden activations, and auto-label the resulting stylistic axes. On Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct, top two axes match human stylistic dimensions with 72.8% precision and 75.6% polar-generation accuracy. Discoverability is model-dependent, dropping to 35.3% precision on DeepSeek-7B-Chat.
